title: Optimizing Microclimate for 1st Instar (Chawki) Rearing
summary: Young silkworm larvae have high moisture content (85%) and fragile epicuticles. Learn why 27–28°C and 85–90% RH are critical to prevent larval mortality.
content: During the first instar, young larvae hatch with thin cuticle membranes that rapidly lose water if ambient humidity drops below 80%. Target temperature should strictly remain at 27.0°C to 28.0°C. Never allow direct sun or heavy air currents to hit the beds. Operate ultrasonic foggers in pulse intervals of 3 minutes ON / 7 minutes OFF to maintain humidity without wetting leaf feed.
recommended_action: Maintain 27–28°C, keep ultrasonic mist on pulse mode, and ensure uniform tender chopped mulberry leaves with 78%+ moisture content.
author: CSRTI Mysuru Research Station

title: 1ನೇ ಹಂತದ (ಚಾಕಿ) ಹುಳುಗಳ ಉಷ್ಣತೆ ಮತ್ತು ತೇವಾಂಶ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ
summary: ಎಳೆಯ ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ಹುಳುಗಳ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗಾಗಿ 27–28°C ಉಷ್ಣತೆ ಹಾಗೂ 85–90% ತೇವಾಂಶ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯವಾಗಿದೆ.
content: ಮೊದಲ ಹಂತದ ಚಾಕಿ ಹುಳುಗಳು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ತೇವಾಂಶ 80% ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಮರಿಗಳು ಸಾಯುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಉಷ್ಣತೆಯನ್ನು 27 ರಿಂದ 28 ಡಿಗ್ರಿ ಸೆಲ್ಸಿಯಸ್ ನಡುವೆ ಇರಿಸಿ. ಕೋಣೆಗೆ ಬಿಸಿ ಗಾಳಿ ತಾಗದಂತೆ ಹಸಿ ಗೋಣಿಚೀಲಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿಟಕಿಗಳಿಗೆ ನೇತುಹಾಕಿ ಅಥವಾ ಸೆಟು ಅಲ್ಟ್ರಾಸಾನಿಕ್ ಮಿಸ್ಟರ್ ಬಳಸಿ.
recommended_action: ಕೋಣೆಯ ಉಷ್ಣತೆ 27-28°C ಮತ್ತು ತೇವಾಂಶ 85-90% ಇರುವಂತೆ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ತಾಜಾ, ಎಳೆಯ ಹಿಪ್ಪುನೇರಳೆ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ನೀಡಿ.
author: ಕೇಂದ್ರ ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ (CSRTI) ಮೈಸೂರು

title: Moulting Stage Care & Feed Stoppage Protocol
summary: Moulting (Jwara) requires complete dry bedding and absolute cessation of feeding to ensure uniform skin shedding across the larval batch.
content: When 80% to 85% of larvae have settled for moult (raised head, motionless), mulberry feeding must cease immediately. Spread slaked lime powder (0.5 kg per 100 DFL) uniformly over the bed to dry out ambient bed moisture and absorb excess CO2. Humidity must be kept low (65–70%) during shedding.
recommended_action: Stop feeding once 85% settle; dust slaked lime powder thinly over beds to facilitate smooth cuticle shed.
author: Karnataka State Sericulture Research & Development Institute (KSSRDI)

title: Late Instar Ventilation & CO2 Suffocation Prevention
summary: 5th Instar larvae consume 80% of total lifetime feed, generating substantial metabolic heat, moisture, and CO2.
content: In overcrowded sheds, CO2 concentrations exceeding 1000 ppm retard larval feeding and trigger Flacherie bacterial susceptibility. Setu automated exhaust fans trigger when air freshness drops below 80% (MQ-135 reading), circulating 0.3 m/s fresh air without chilling larvae.
recommended_action: Keep exhaust louvers clear; ensure continuous fresh air exchange while keeping temperature within 23–24.5°C.
author: Central Silk Board Govt of India
